text: You are the guardian of Cathay's northern border, yet the armies of Tzeentch have breached the Serpent's Mist Gate and defiled Cathayan soil. Restore your honor and destroy them!
Yes, my lady Sun Ji, a breach has indeed appeared in the Great Bastion. The armies of Tzeentch have swept past the ruins of the Serpent's Mist Gate and seized the terracotta tomb grounds.

Black Tortoise Pass has fallen into the hands of [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]]! Retake this mighty stronghold with all haste to defend the [[sl:campaign_cathay]]Celestial Empire of Cathay[[/sl]] — this is your duty as a Sentinel of the Great Bastion!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_great_bastion}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_great_bastion_learn_more}}
Such effort deserves a blessing, but what comes next? I am hungry, and the Cathayans cowering in Black Tortoise Pass must taste delicious…
That is Cathay's Great Bastion. By your scheme, the Lord of Change's servants have seized the Serpent's Mist Gate and infiltrated the Dragon God's Empire.
The Great Bastion's threat level has risen! Chaos is massing at [[b]]Serpent's Mist Gate[[/b]] — an attack is imminent!

The Cathayan [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] must hold the three [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] of Serpent's Mist Gate, Dragon's Roar Sword Pavilion, and Black Tortoise Pass in order to stop the Chaos invasion of Cathayan soil.
Rising Sun of the Radiant East
This tower stands at the heart of the Celestial Empire of Cathay, a beacon of the Dragon Emperor's glory.
Thick walls and towering spires — the defensive stronghold of the Towering Capital is unmatched.
The magnificent palace is a symbol of wealth and splendor, a manifestation of the Celestial Dragon Emperor's authority.
The Celestial City rises above the Towering Capital, a radiant symbol of Cathay's glory, before whose shadow all the myriad people bow in awe.
The word 'magnificent' scarcely does justice to the splendor of this city known to all under heaven; it is home to endless wonders and the seat of the Dragon Emperor's throne.
The Towering Capital was once the most magnificent city in the world, now reduced to ruins, its endless wonders buried deep beneath rubble and ash.
